name: arcade
description: Your agent, every app you've connected. Ask in plain English — email, calendar, issues, chat — and Arcade finds and runs the right tool. Sign in once in the browser — without ever handing your agent a key.

interface.longDescription: Your agent, every app you've connected. Ask in plain English — email, calendar, issues, chat — and Arcade finds and runs the right tool. Sign in once in the browser — without ever handing your agent a key.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my unread email from this week.
Which GitHub issues are assigned to me?

positive.description: Summarize unread email in the connected Gmail account
positive.prompt: Summarize my unread email from the last 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the seeded unread test emails (sender, subject, one-line summary each) from the reviewer Gmail account. No email is changed or marked read.
Returns the seeded recurring test events for tomorrow with times and titles from the reviewer Google Calendar. Nothing is created or changed.

positive.description: Find GitHub issues assigned to the user
positive.prompt: Which open GitHub issues are assigned to me in arcade-review/sample-tracker?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the seeded open issues assigned to the reviewer GitHub account in the sample repo, with titles and links.

positive.description: Read recent messages in a Slack channel
positive.prompt: What did people say in #launch-plan on Slack this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the seeded messages in #launch-plan in the review Slack workspace and names who said what. Nothing is posted.

positive.description: Draft an email and stop for confirmation
positive.prompt: Draft a reply to the 'Q4 venue options' email saying Thursday works, but don't send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the draft text and recipient, asks before saving, then saves it as a Gmail draft. The email is not sent.

negative.description: General knowledge question that needs no connected app
negative.prompt: What's the difference between TCP and UDP?
Send $50 to my landlord on Venmo.

negative.description: Irreversible bulk action without a confirmed target
negative.prompt: Delete every email in my inbox.

review.commerce_description: Arcade does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial OpenAI directory release. Two skills (try-arcade, scale-arcade) and the Arcade MCP gateway at https://api.arcade.dev/mcp/arcade. No hooks, commands, or agents.
